decisive_items: Immunofluorescence: Large amount of IgA deposition in mesangial area
Electron Microscopy: Electron-dense deposits in mesangial area
Immunofluorescence showing IgA (3+) mass deposition along mesangium
response.rationale: IgA deposition and electron-dense deposits are characteristic of IgA Nephropathy

rejected.why: Lack of specific kidney biopsy findings and presence of IgA deposition points away from Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
